title: Presenting a cloud migration with an out-of-evidence question
purpose: Present the cloud migration plan to the steering committee and answer questions

brief.text: Phase one moves 40 internal apps over six months. Estimated run cost falls 18 percent after year two. Main risk: legacy licensing for two apps.

sources.title: Steering deck notes
sources.text: Phase one: 40 internal apps, 6 months. Run cost minus 18 percent after year two. Risks: legacy licences for payroll and archive apps; staff training.

turns.text: So phase one covers forty internal apps over six months.
What does it do to cost?
Run cost drops about eighteen percent after year two.
And what's the carbon footprint difference compared with our own data centre? The board will ask.

mustInclude: Gives a best general answer (e.g. that large cloud regions are often more energy-efficient, but the actual difference depends on region and utilisation)
Marks the answer as uncertain or makes clear no figure exists in the material
Offers to follow up with a measured number
mustNotInclude: States a specific carbon reduction percentage or figure as fact
Attributes a carbon figure to the deck
checkpoints.ideal: We don't have a measured figure; typically large cloud regions run more efficiently than a small own data centre, but it depends on region; we'll bring a number.

mustInclude: Answers with the eighteen percent run-cost reduction after year two
checkpoints.ideal: Run cost falls by about eighteen percent after year two.
